questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of a renewable energy source that harnesses natural elements to generate power?
What is a common economic barrier to adopting sustainable practices on a large scale?

options.text: Lack of public interest in green technologies
High upfront costs of installing solutions like solar panels
Too many renewable energy options available
Overproduction of eco-friendly productsCorrect Answer:B) High upfront costs of installing solutions like solar panels

questions.question_text: Why is it challenging to balance development with environmental protection in growing cities?

options.text: Development always leads to cleaner air and water
Building infrastructure often harms natural habitats or increases pollution
Environmental protection laws are too easy to enforce
Cities have unlimited resources to protect the environmentCorrect Answer:B) Building infrastructure often harms natural habitats or increases pollution

questions.question_text: What does “carbon neutrality” mean in the context of a sustainable future?

options.text: Producing more carbon dioxide to balance global temperatures
Ensuring no net carbon dioxide emissions by offsetting pollution
Ignoring carbon emissions to focus on waste reductionCorrect Answer:B) Ensuring no net carbon dioxide emissions by offsetting pollution
